title: Darling In The Franxx
description: Artwork drawn from _Darling in the FranXX_, a mecha anime with a distinctive futuristic setting. The collection includes giant mechs, desolate landscapes, and the series' bold color palette, reflecting its blend of science fiction and youthful, emotional themes.
